alphabet.name: Latin Alphabet (Italian)
alphabet.letters: A B C D E F G H I L M N O P Q R S T U V Z
alphabet.accents: à è é ì î ò ó ù
alphabet.note: Italian officially uses 21 letters (J, K, W, X, Y appear only in foreign words). Very phonetic language.
alphabet.pronunciation_guide: Double consonants are pronounced long. C before E/I sounds like CH. G before E/I sounds like J.
